name: m5-kwu-scaling-wall

variantDescriptions.t1: one compile at a time, 15 warmup compiles (6 left C2 still compiling in the measurement, job 569)
variantDescriptions.t8: 8 independent compiles at once, each its own `Global`; 3 warmup iterations = 24 compiles

description: Wall-clock profile at 1 and at 8 concurrent compiles: time the compile threads spend off-CPU (waiting, parked, descheduled, safepoints) that a cpu profile does not show.

Build `claude/uniques-audit` `41986b33ea` with `-Yuniques-layout:chunked-weak` and `-Yuniques-uncache all` (ChunkedInterner(weak = true), types made in the weak scopes not interned). Scala corpus, 24 GB G1 heap, laptop, one fork per variant.
